UFC_Fight_Night:_Moicano_vs._Nolan.name: UFC Fight Night: Moicano vs. Nolan

items.title: Tom Nolan makes permanent City Kickboxing move before Moicano fight
items.blurb: Tom Nolan has moved permanently from Australia to New Zealand to join Eugene Bareman ’s City Kickboxing gym in Auckland ahead of the biggest fight of his Ultimate Fighting Championship career.

items.title: Tom Nolan says MMA helped him escape troubled hometown before UFC main event
items.blurb: Tom Nolan hopes his rise to the Ultimate Fighting Championship main event spotlight can inspire aspiring fighters to pursue their ambitions, regardless of where they come from.

items.title: Renato Moicano plans to test free agency after UFC contract expires
items.blurb: Renato “Money” Moicano intends to fight out his Ultimate Fighting Championship contract and explore free agency.
